lead_headline: Hearth Patisserie expands to Highlands as restaurant tracker logs one new opening against 14-closure week

restaurant.blurb: 1 new lead today: Hearth Patisserie (third location) opens at 3617 W 32nd Ave in Highlands Square. 14 closures this week — tracker quiet ahead of Labor Day weekend.

liquor.blurb: Zero applications Saturday as weekend filing freeze continues. One status upgrade: SAFTA Denver clears delinquency to active at 3330 N Brighton. Week finishes at 3 applications — matching prior week's baseline as liquor board confirms sustained administrative velocity after multi-month backlog purge. Three-license week validates 5-8 weekly cadence as new normal following record 267-application dump cycle.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions Saturday extends BusinessDen citation blackout to 18 consecutive days — unprecedented silence now spans three full weeks without single media pickup. All-time total remains frozen at 1,167 mentions from 111 sources since August 5. Past 30 days: 40 mentions (down from 56 yesterday as July data rolls off). 18-day void surpasses every prior gap in multi-year tracking — either syndication feeds severed, monitoring infrastructure failed, or industry citation patterns fundamentally shifted mid-August with zero detectable signals.
